attempts.summary: Deduplicated node1’s release cache safely. The matching 0644 payloads now share one inode, reclaiming 1.81 KiB. All paths, bytes, ownership, modes, and the installed Alpine 3.23.3 / kernel 6.18.7-0-lts were preserved. The private 0600 and mutable files remain independent. Repeated passes made no changes, including after reboot.
